nodes.description: CIROZ is a secreted protein expressed specifically in the left-right organizer and is a member of the conserved LRO module (with DAND5, PKD1L1, MMP21 and CIROP); it is essential for normal situs in humans and mice. Its precise molecular step within that module is not established: the defining study states that the exact role of CIROZ in the LRO, and its functional relationship to the other module proteins, remain to be determined. This node therefore records the loss of an LRO-restricted module factor, not a specified signalling step (see the attached knowledge gap).
